title: Machine learning integrated bulk and single cell transcriptomic analyses reveal oxidative stress associated mitochondrial polarization signatures in diabetic foot ulcers.
authors: Guo, Zeao; Zeng, Zhaoyang; Ma, Xuepeng; Jing, Shuai-Shuai; Wu, Yu; Shan, Bin; Pan, Haibang; Shi, Yuhong; Liu, Ai; Jiang, Hugang; Li, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习整合bulk和单细胞转录组分析糖尿病足溃疡中的氧化应激相关线粒体极化特征，虽涉及转录因子调控网络但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) are a major complication of diabetes, and its pathogenesis remains incompletely elucidated. Converging evidence indicates that oxidative stress and dysregulated mitochondrial polarization participate in DFU progression, nominating these processes as therapeutically actionable targets. This study integrates bulk and single-cell transcriptomic data with machine learning to reconstruct cross-scale, cell type-resolved molecular atlases and regulatory networks. Macrophages and fibroblasts emerged as communication hubs, dominating pathway enrichment and ligand-receptor programs such as macrophage migration inhibitory factor signaling pathway (MIF), ANNEXIN signaling pathway, and COMPLEMENT signaling pathway. Peptidylprolyl isomerase F (PPIF), which encodes cyclophilin D (CypD) and apolipoprotein E (APOE) were further prioritized as putative drivers within macrophages and fibroblasts, and a five-gene classifier was derived with robust performance (internal/external AUC = 0.833/0.933). Within DFU lesions, under the control of non-coding RNA circuitry, SOX5 may shape the inflammatory microenvironment, APOE may participate in lipid-metabolic remodeling, and PPIF (CypD) likely links reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation to a p53-dependent mitochondrial death pathway (necroptosis/apoptosis). Orthogonal validation showed significantly increased CypD in diabetic foot ulcer skin (DFUS) and diabetic foot ulcer tendon (DFUT) relative to diabetic foot skin (DFS) and DFT (Diabetic foot tendon), with up-regulated p53 and Cytc and down-regulated ApoE in DFUS; in primary foot-skin fibroblasts, a high-glucose plus tert-butyl hydroperoxide (HG+TBHP) model reproduced elevated ROS, loss of mitochondrial Deltapsim (mitochondrial membrane potential), growth restriction, and apoptosis, supporting a ROS-CypD/mPTP (mitochondrial permeability transition pore)-Deltapsim depolarization-p53/Cytc apoptosis axis. The delineated PPIF-centered regulatory network includes upstream transcription factors CEBPB/REL/SPI1 and a downstream ceRNA axis comprising miR-128-3p/miR-23a-3p-long non-coding RNA OIP5-AS1. Additionally, the significant role of polarization-specific reprogramming in regulating macrophage function highlights therapeutic strategies focused on metabolic reprogramming and inhibition of the PPIF/mPTP pathway. Collectively, a cell type-resolved molecular map of DFU is provided, healing-relevant cell populations and regulatory circuits are prioritized, and a translational, testable intervention framework is proposed.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病足溃疡（DFU）是糖尿病的主要并发症，其发病机制尚未完全阐明。越来越多的证据表明，氧化应激和线粒体极化失调参与DFU的进展，提示这些过程可作为治疗干预靶点。本研究整合批量及单细胞转录组数据与机器学习，重建跨尺度、细胞类型分辨的分子图谱和调控网络。巨噬细胞和成纤维细胞被识别为通讯枢纽，主导通路富集及配体-受体程序，如巨噬细胞迁移抑制因子信号通路（MIF）、膜联蛋白信号通路（ANNEXIN）和补体信号通路（COMPLEMENT）。肽基脯氨酰异构酶F（PPIF），其编码亲环蛋白D（CypD），以及载脂蛋白E（APOE）被进一步优先确定为巨噬细胞和成纤维细胞中的推定驱动因子，并推导出一个五基因分类器，其性能稳健（内部/外部AUC = 0.833/0.933）。在DFU病变中，在非编码RNA调控网络的控制下，SOX5可能塑造炎症微环境，APOE可能参与脂质代谢重塑，而PPIF（CypD）可能将活性氧（ROS）积累与p53依赖性线粒体死亡通路（坏死性凋亡/凋亡）联系起来。正交验证显示，与糖尿病足皮肤（DFS）和糖尿病足肌腱（DFT）相比，糖尿病足溃疡皮肤（DFUS）和糖尿病足溃疡肌腱（DFUT）中CypD显著升高，DFUS中p53和Cytc上调、ApoE下调；在原代足部皮肤成纤维细胞中，高糖加叔丁基过氧化氢（HG+TBHP）模型重现了ROS升高、线粒体Δψm（线粒体膜电位）丧失、生长受限和凋亡，支持ROS-CypD/mPTP（线粒体通透性转换孔）-Δψm去极化-p53/Cytc凋亡轴。所描绘的以PPIF为中心的调控网络包括上游转录因子CEBPB/REL/SPI1和下游ceRNA轴，包含miR-128-3p/miR-23a-3p-长链非编码RNA OIP5-AS1。此外，极化特异性重编程在调节巨噬细胞功能中的显著作用，强调了聚焦于代谢重编程和抑制PPIF/mPTP通路的治疗策略。总体而言，本研究提供了DFU的细胞类型分辨分子图谱，优先确定了与愈合相关的细胞群体和调控回路，并提出了一个可转化、可测试的干预框架。
